violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Withholding Active Play (26 TAC §744.2105(8))
violation_type.typical_finding: Caregivers were overheard telling children they would "owe them 5 minutes" for not following directions or stay inside instead of going outside during their playground time  for continuing to roll around the room on the rolling chairs after being asked to stop.

finding_variants.text: Caregivers were overheard telling children they would "owe them 5 minutes" for not following directions or stay inside instead of going outside during their playground time  for continuing to roll around the room on the rolling chairs after being asked to stop.
It was determined that a caregiver did not allow a group of children to participate in active play when they were unable to complete a task.
Outdoor play was withheld from the children during today's inspection due to the children's behavior.
